headline: Italy seeks solution for mothballed Ilva steel works as buyer costs linger
summary: Rome is attempting to secure the future of the mothballed Ilva steel facility, Europe's largest plant, with two prospective buyers identified while questions remain over who will fund necessary investments.
why: The Ilva steelworks is crucial for Italy's manufacturing supply chain, but heavy losses and decarbonization costs have complicated past privatization attempts.

impacts.name: European Steel
impacts.why: Resolution of Ilva's ownership will determine production restarts in southern Europe.
